themes.label: AI listed among multiplying global challenges
themes.definition: AI is named briefly in a list of global challenges or threats (conflict, climate, migration, inequality) without further discussion of AI itself.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears only as one item in an enumeration of global challenges or threats.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that go on to discuss AI's specific risks, uses or governance.
themes.boundary_cases: Lists of technologies (rather than challenges) go to AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION; the phrase 'unchecked rise' signals mild concern but not substantive discussion.

examples.quote: rising inequality or even the unchecked rise of artificial intelligence, those challenges jeopardize our present and our future
Climate change, migration, the advent of artificial intelligence. Our world is changing.

value.rationale: Both Greek passages mention AI only in passing as one of several global challenges framing a call for multilateral cooperation and respect for international law; there is no substantive AI discussion.
